summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with the eleven members in table order, each commented. botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config (no variant tags), and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (23 tests, deriving from unittest.TestCase). Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed. Full unit suite: 11 failures, identical list before and after my change (pre-existing, e.g. test_awsrequest, test_session). Nothing committed. Caveats: FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private methods (_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var, _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint) since no public lookup exists; "custom endpoint data" is read as not uses_builtin_data; black was not available in the venv, so formatting was checked only by a script for the 79-column limit.
